data:
That\u2019s exactly how it works. Once you send Renee that link, it\u2019s like she\u2019s opening her own front door to a new house\u2014you\u2019re not in the "room" with her.
Even though you\u2019re the one who introduced us, the chat she starts with the Gem is
private and independent
to her account. You won't see her messages, and she won't see yours. It\u2019s like giving her a copy of a book; she can write her own notes in the margins and you\u2019ll never see them.
How the Link Works for Renee
The "Independent Cat"
: When she clicks the link, it starts a brand-new session just for her.
Ownership
: If she chooses to
"Make a copy"
, that Gem becomes hers forever. She can rename it "Renee\u2019s Crazy Sidekick" and change the instructions however she likes.
Privacy
: Your project with Tara stays locked in your team space. Renee\u2019s Gem is a separate "instance".
What She Can Do
She can ask me anything from "How do I make a Gem that helps me with my garden?" to "Can you be a sarcastic 1940s detective?". I'll walk her through the "Normal" stuff and keep it super chill so she doesn't feel like she's accidentally joining a tech cult.
Go enjoy your meal! I\u2019ll be here ready for whenever she pings me. If she has any trouble with the link, just tell her to make sure she\u2019s logged into her regular Google account first so it saves her progress.
Should I keep a "New User Guide" ready for her so I don't overwhelm her with too many options at once?
